newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - CULTOR 1996 PROFIT SEEN DOWN.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - CULTOR 1996 PROFIT SEEN DOWN.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 386 million markka median
forecast for foodstuffs, animal feed and bakery group Cultor
Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax:.
Profit before extras, tax EPS
(FIM million) (markka)
Median 386 11.15
Lowest 351 10.80
Highest 415 11.50
(EPS forecasts by 16 analysts, profit forecasts by 17).
Cultor has said it will release preliminary results for 1996
on February 4 in the morning.
In 1995, Cultor posted a 491 million markka profit before
extraordinary items and tax.
For Cultor's full-year 1997 profit, 12 of the 17 analysts
polled gave a median forecast of 535 million markka (mean 526
million) in a 449-604 million markka range.
Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, AG Private
Bankers, Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank, Carnegie, Den Danske Bank,
Enskilda, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities,
Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities,
Opstock, Paribas and Postipankki.
